overview.description: Simplify Brookwood Global Macro ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks capital appreciation by investing globally across equities, debt, currencies, and commodities. The fund takes an opportunistic approach with no fixed asset-allocation targets and may take both long and short positions across asset classes. Its global macro strategy seeks to capitalize on broad economic and political changes and related market themes. The ETF is listed on NYSE Arca under the ticker GMAC.
